turn_text: Well, biological opinions are supposed to be updated every few years. And it's law, but it's also the biological opinions are basically the manual on how to operate the pumps. And so there's a set of pumps in the Delta that move water into the front. The aqueduct and the aqueduct that either goes straight to southern California or goes up into San Luis Reservoir. But the biological opinions are basically the instructions on how to operate the pump so you can do as little damage as possible to the environment and to any species that we have to try to protect.

And the Bureau of Reclamation has looked into reversing those 2019 opinions going, which would, I guess, take it back to the 2008, 2009 Obama era opinions. And we know you have started an investigation into that reversal. Can you just take us through your investigation?

Well, I'm not the actual one that's doing the investigation. The committee's going to do that. But what's going on there is is obviously the biological opinions of 29 team biological opinions that were signed by President Trump. I believe for political reasons. President Biden and Gavin Newsom were both opposed to the biological opinions. And so this new President Biden started what we call the re-consultation process, which is restarting the biological opinions that basically pulled them back. And so there's been a little bit of a legal fight, but we've been sending letters to the administration, to the Bureau of Act, Secretary of Interior. continually asking what was the basis for the decision to do that, because the current biological opinions weren't something that were started under the Trump administration. They had been started under the Obama administration, and it's all done by career staff. The career staff had been there. during both presidency. So it's not like it's a bunch of political appointees making these decisions. President Trump just moved it along. And so we found no basis for this re-consultation and they're not responding to any of our questions. So that tells us that they also have no basis for it or else they would tell us what the basis was for making that decision. We even took it to a point where on appropriations I offered an amendment last year in committee and a lot of the Democrats voted in opposition to it, which was really disappointing because the amendment was pretty simple.
